name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager with subscriber management, campaigns, templates and analytics, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER and LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables; they only apply on the first start. Then set Root URL to your https:// domain under Settings > General, and configure an SMTP server under Settings > SMTP before sending campaigns.
